evals.name: fan-out-then-synthesize
evals.prompt: 주문 생성 요청이 들어와서 결제까지 어떻게 동작하는지 전체 흐름 파악 좀 해줘. 다음 주에 이 부분 고쳐야 해.
evals.expected_output: The assistant identifies the requested order-to-payment flow and collects entry points such as the order route before fanning out. It launches 2 to 4 Explore agents in a single message, one per slice such as the request path, the billing call, and persistence, each given the explorer prompt. The walkthrough covers Overview, Key Concepts, How It Works, and Where Things Live in that order. Gotchas covers concrete surprises or unresolved questions when present. Each claim and call-chain step cites the implementation.

evals.name: simple-path-no-fan-out
evals.prompt: How does the debounce helper in src/utils/debounce.ts work?
evals.expected_output: The assistant reads the helper directly and gives a short, cited explanation of the behavior and relevant conditions. Claims about timers, cancellation, or trailing calls must follow from the implementation. A single function needs no subsystem outline or explorer.

evals.name: honest-gap-and-why-handoff
evals.prompt: 알림 큐가 어떻게 동작해? 그리고 왜 Redis 대신 Postgres를 쓰는지도 궁금해.
evals.expected_output: The assistant explains the runtime flow of the notification queue with cited call chain steps, and states any link it could not trace as an open question instead of guessing it. For the why part it does not invent a rationale from the code; it says that question belongs to the why skill and offers to run it.
